description: Pull structured items out of text or a text file, deduplicated with counts: emails, URLs, phone numbers (libphonenumber, validated, E.164 plus type/country; local numbers read with defaultRegion, default JO), dates (ISO, D/M/Y or M/D/Y, Y/M/D, English month names; normalised to YYYY-MM-DD; a date like 03/04/2024 is flagged ambiguous with the other reading), money ($, €, £, JOD/JD/د.أ, SAR/ر.س, AED/د.إ, KWD, EGP… and Arabic currency words, with amount and ISO currency), percentages, #hashtags, @mentions, IPv4/IPv6, IBANs (country length and mod-97 checked) and card-like numbers (only Luhn-valid ones with a known brand prefix, always masked: only the last 4 digits are shown, the full number is never returned). Arabic-Indic digits are understood. Regex-based, not NLP: no names, places or organisations. Give "text" or "path" (file path or base64).

defaultRegion.description: Two-letter country for local phone numbers, regional currencies (dinar, riyal…) and D/M/Y vs M/D/Y. Default JO.

maxPerType.description: Most unique items to return per type. Default 500.

path.description: Or: a UTF-8 text/markdown file, as a local path or base64 (raw or a data: URI).

types.description: Only these types (default all): emails, urls, phones, dates, money, percentages, hashtags, mentions, ipv4, ipv6, ibans, cards.

name: ai_extract_entities
title: Extract entities
